_about: Placement rules of the main Swiss road signs (Signalisationsverordnung SSV, SR 741.21, Stand 1. Juli 2025), for the sign steps of the pipeline (signs_net.py, signs_more.py) and their review. Distances in metres along the road before the place the sign is about. 'verified': true where the SSV text (or the cited directive) states it; false for the practice of this project. Human summary: beamng/verifica/v3/markings/REGOLE.md.

BE_T30.title: Kanton Bern TBA: Arbeitshilfe Tempo-30-Zone und Begegnungszone (2026)

LU_T30.title: Kanton Luzern vif: Richtlinie Tempo-30-Zonen und Begegnungszonen 653.112

side.rule: right edge of the road; may be repeated on the left, over the road, on islands; only left in compelling exceptions (Art. 103 Abs. 1)

lateral_clearance.rule: from the carriageway edge to the nearest edge of the plate (Art. 103 Abs. 4)

plate_bottom_height.rule: over the crown of the road (Art. 103 Abs. 3)

not_dense.rule: signs must not stand close together (Art. 101 Abs. 5); not without need, not missing where indispensable, uniform along a road (Art. 101 Abs. 3)

size.rule: normal size on main and minor roads, small size allowed inside villages and on field tracks and exits (Art. 102 Abs. 2)

pre_signal_distance.rule: pre-signals of information signs with the distance plate 5.01 (Art. 44 Abs. 3)

distance.inside: shortly before the danger; over 50 m before: distance plate 5.01
distance.motorway: at the danger or up to 100 m before, plus a pre-signal 500-1000 m before

danger_signs.rule: only where a driver who does not know the place cannot see the danger, or sees it too late (Art. 3 Abs. 2); repeated on long stretches, length on plate 5.03 (Art. 3 Abs. 4)

curve.rule: bends that force a lower speed by their layout (missing superelevation, strong or uneven curvature); several bends in short succession: the sign of the first with the length plate 5.03; inside villages as a rule none (Art. 4)

pedestrian_crossing_warning.rule: announces crossings not recognisable from 200 m; only outside villages and only at crossings meeting the state of the art (Art. 11 Abs. 1)

children.rule: near schools, playgrounds and the like (Art. 11 Abs. 2)

stop.rule: right edge shortly before the junction; repeated on the left with several lanes the same way; moved back more than 10 m: distance plate 5.01 (Art. 36 Abs. 4-5); only where the lack of sight makes a stop indispensable (Art. 36 Abs. 7); with the stop line 6.10 and the word STOP 6.11 on paved roads (Art. 75 Abs. 2)

give_way.rule: right edge shortly before the junction (Art. 36 Abs. 4); with the give-way line 6.13 on paved roads (Art. 75 Abs. 4); may be pre-signalled with distance plate on main roads losing priority, outside 150-250 m, inside about 50 m (Art. 36 Abs. 8)

main_road.rule: at its start; repeated inside villages shortly before, outside shortly after each junction; may be missing at unimportant junctions (Art. 37 Abs. 2)

end_of_main_road.rule: right edge shortly before the junction, plus a pre-signal with distance plate outside 150-250 m, inside about 50 m before (Art. 38 Abs. 2)

junction_with_minor_road.rule: on minor roads, announces a junction where the driver has priority; inside villages it may be missing where the stop/give-way signs or lines of the side road are visible in time (Art. 39)

junction_right_of_way.rule: only where the road from the right cannot be seen in time, or after several 3.05 junctions (Art. 40 Abs. 2)

roundabout.rule: before the entry under the give-way sign 3.02; may be repeated on the central island (Art. 24 Abs. 4)
roundabout.note: the task named '2.41.1 or 4.04/2.41': in the SSV 2.41 is 'Geradeaus oder Linksabbiegen' and 4.04 is not a roundabout sign; the roundabout is 2.41.1 over 3.02

keep_right_of_obstacle.name: Hindernis rechts umfahren
keep_right_of_obstacle.rule: at the obstacle (island) the driver must pass on the right (Art. 24 Abs. 1b); on splitter and refuge islands, facing the approaching traffic
keep_right_of_obstacle.note: the task named 2.33: in the SSV 2.33 is 'Fahrtrichtung links' (turn left ahead); 2.34 is keep right

pedestrian_crossing_location.rule: always at crossings outside villages and at unexpected or badly visible crossings inside; one sign visible from both directions is enough on the island of crossings with islands, and at the edge on narrow minor roads (Art. 47 Abs. 1)

place_name.rule: white on blue on main roads, black on white on minor roads; where the loosely built-up area begins, not after the general 50 sign; the back shows the next place and the next far destination with its distance (Art. 50)

general_50.rule: where the dense building begins on one side of the road; the end where neither side is densely built; may be missing on unimportant minor roads (Art. 22 Abs. 3-4)

zone_30.rule: at every entrance of the zone, which must look like a gate (UVEK ordinance SR 741.213.3 Art. 5); the 'ZONE 30' marking only with the sign at the entrance

direction_sign.rule: names places first, important local points if needed; at most three lines per arm (Art. 49, 51)

advance_direction_sign.rule: at the latest at the start of the turning lanes; junctions less than 300 m apart on one sign; before roundabouts the roundabout form 4.54 (Art. 52)

direction_signs_at_roundabouts.rule: one direction sign per exit, at the exit (on the splitter island or the right of the exit), naming the places reached by that arm
direction_signs_at_roundabouts.note: Swiss practice (VSS 40 817-type layouts, not public); the SSV only names the advance sign 4.54
